rounds.text: The valuation is unsupported because a discounted cash flow model puts intrinsic value at ₹ 117 per share against a market price of ₹ 153, resulting in a negative margin of safety of -30.3% [E42, E43]. This overvaluation is confirmed by a rules-based screen scoring 53 out of a hundred with a sell rating and low confidence [E61]. Fundamental performance over longer horizons remains weak, highlighted by a 5-year compounded profit growth of -2% and a 3-year profit growth of -5% [E17, E18], alongside a low 3-year average return on equity of 10.2% [E58]. Institutional support has evaporated, demonstrated by domestic institutions slashing their holdings from 1.70% to 0.02% and negative institutional money flow [E40, E41]. Furthermore, technical momentum is entirely broken as the stock trades below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, accompanied by a twelve-month price return of -30.7% and a weak relative-strength rating of 35 [E47, E48, E49]. Conceded: the company trades at a P/E of 14.4x which sits below sector benchmarks [E1, E6].
